PyYAML (pure SafeLoader) and ruamel.yaml (YAML(typ='safe', pure=True)) are pure-Python loaders with Python line coverage of their own package. PyYAML CSafeLoader is a separate route of the same PyPI package (its metric is the PyYAML package value, not a split) whose scanner/parser is libyaml 0.2.5, built from source with LLVM coverage and linked statically into _yaml. ruamel.yaml.clib is ruamel.yaml's C loader package with its own metric; its vendored C is an older libyaml snapshot (96.1% of distinct lines shared with libyaml 0.2.5), so it shares the libyaml family with the CSafeLoader path. srsly.yaml_loads is a labelled wrapper over the same pure ruamel.yaml route; its own lines are identical on both controls. rapidyaml is the Python binding of the C++ rapidyaml parser (same family as the C++ cell path): the pinned sdist is built with its own SWIG/CMake build and LLVM coverage, and because ryml keeps scalars as untyped text the adapter types plain scalars with YAML 1.2 core-schema patterns (adapter-side typing). yamlcore.CoreLoader is a labelled wrapper over PyYAML's pure BaseLoader with its own YAML 1.2 core resolver/constructors. Native routes report LLVM regions of the parser C; Python routes report executed lines; each has three identical AFL++ runs per control that differ in scanner/parser sources.
